## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
Sector Rotation, not Risk-Off. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Consumer Discretionary); cyclicals (Consumer Discretionary, Financials, Materials) leading but there is a MAJOR divergence among large caps—watch for trend break.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads: TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +20.59%), GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +18.86%), TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.59% | 1M: +16.84%). Financials strong: COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +19.54%), USB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +14.62%), JPM CORRECTION (1W: -1.78% | 1M: +3.15%). Materials notable: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +15.18%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities lag: AEP RECOVERY (1W: +1.33% | 1M: -4.98%), Utilities avg -2.86%. Energy lagging: XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -1.22%), CVX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -2.93%). Real Estate showing weakness on the averages (sector avg -0.64%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +23.32%), TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +20.59%), COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +19.54%), GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +18.86%), TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.59% | 1M: +16.84%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Consumer Discretionary); Style: Value/Cyclical favored given breadth.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: GILD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -4.59%), TMUS RECOVERY (1W: +2.71% | 1M: -4.65%), AEP RECOVERY (1W: +1.33% | 1M: -4.98%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -6.70%), NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -12.38% | 1M: -7.16%). Weakness concentrated in Tech and select Communication names—reduce exposure to laggards.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves: TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +20.59%), NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -12.38% | 1M: -7.16%), AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -7.77%), AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -9.91%). TMUS RECOVERY (1W: +2.71% | 1M: -4.65%) is a short-term bounce to watch; major divergence among AAPL, MSFT, JPM suppresses strong regime calls.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with clear internal dispersion; META ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.14% | 1M: +12.55%) while NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -6.70%), NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -12.38% | 1M: -7.16%), AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -7.77%). Sector breadth: Tech: 9/19 positive — selective names showing strength, but breadth is mixed.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials broadly constructive: COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +19.54%), USB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +14.62%), JPM CORRECTION (1W: -1.78% | 1M: +3.15%). Sector breadth: Financials: 15/20 positive — cyclicals confirming rotation into value.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed but with pockets of strength: BMY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +16.75%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.28% | 1M: +1.10%), GILD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -4.59%). Sector breadth: Healthcare: 10/15 positive — defensive names not currently leading.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Consumer Discretionary and Financials (TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +20.59%), COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +19.54%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +15.18%)). Reduce exposure to late-cycle Tech laggards (NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -6.70%), NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -12.38% | 1M: -7.16%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.53% | 1M: -20.42%)). Style: Value/Cyclical favored but MAJOR divergence warrants tactical sizing and monitoring.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +20.59%), COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +19.54%), EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +23.32%). BEARISH: NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -12.38% | 1M: -7.16%), AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -7.77%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.53% | 1M: -20.42%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (Breadth: 10/12 positive) and Financials (Breadth: 15/20 positive) as rotation continues. BEARISH: Technology (Breadth: 9/19 positive) and Energy (Breadth: 3/8 positive) for potential further underperformance.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -6.70%) — watch break of recent 1M lows as trend confirm trigger. AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -2.88% | 1M: +0.64%) — monitor 1W support for signs of resumed uptrend. TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +20.59%) — watch for continuation above this week’s high as momentum confirm.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Sector Rotation into cyclicals with Value/Cyclical style bias; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive and leadership is Narrow (3/5 Consumer Discretionary). TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +20.59%), COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +19.54%), EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +23.32%) showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across large caps (AAPL CORRECTION, MSFT RECOVERY, JPM CORRECTION) — watch for trend breaks before broadening exposure.
